name: Deeper Club
storyline:
Welcome to a post pandemic japan for hypers!

The Hyperona, a virus, contaminates the entire world, causing its victims to grow bigger in many ways. A vaccine which side effects make them more enclined to get hungry and excited. People growing used to their now enhanced body while new trends see the daylight, one of these being vore.

The year is 2031 you are trying to get a job in this crazy world.

Good luck.
summary: Deeper Club is a visual novel with dating sim mechanics based around sex and vore. The game follows the story of Melo, a mouse who's life is an everyday struggle not to succomb to his own needs or other predators.
